data.name: Athilah
data.gender_notes: Athilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'az-Zalilah' which means 'the Exalted, the Generous'. It is a name of high esteem and respect, often given to girls who are expected to grow up to be noble and generous individuals. The name Athilah carries the meaning “Noble, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Athilah usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with spiritual significance, symbolizing the qualities of kindness, generosity, and nobility.
data.etymology: Athilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Athilah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

historical_references.reference: Al-Athir al-Nobakhti mentions 'Athilah b. Sa'id as a companion of Caliph 'Ali in his book 'Al-Futuh.'
historical_references.context: During the caliphate of 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth Rashidun Caliph, 'Athilah b. Sa'id was a prominent companion and fighter.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abi Shaybah records that 'Athilah b. Sa'id was a notable Sahabi (Companion) of the Prophet Muhammad and a Muhaddith (scholar of Hadith).
historical_references.context: 'Athilah b. Sa'id was a pious and knowledgeable individual during the time of the Prophet Muhammad, and played a significant role in the preservation and transmission of Hadith.
